name: EgyCon
blurb: Egypt's anime and gaming festival in New Cairo, with cosplay contests, gaming tournaments, an artist bazaar and esports brackets.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Upcoming Event ... Scheduled for Friday, October 30, 2026 At Family Park, New Cairo, Egypt'

notes: Seed cited 'EGYCON 13 set for April 10 2026', but that date is now in the past relative to this 2026-10-05 research window; the site's own homepage instead advertises its next event for 2026-10-30 at Family Park, New Cairo (ticket link slug 'halloween-iii', and the gallery references 'EGYCON 8 Highlights' and a Spacetoon concert from past events), which is the edition recorded here. The homepage describes cosplay, gaming tournaments/esports, an artist & merch area and a bazaar, but never mentions a celebrity/VIP guest program the way the other researched cons do, and no guest or lineup page/link could be found on the site (its nav appears to be JS-routed with no plain links beyond the ticket countdown), so guests is left as 'none-yet' rather than assumed. Seed types (anime, scifi, comics, cosplay) were narrowed to anime/games/cosplay to match what the live site actually describes (its own meta description calls it 'Egypt's ultimate anime & gaming convention'); no scifi or comics content was evidenced for this edition. No organizer entity name was given on the page.
